title: Kitsuno Handshake — Signal (conversation result event)
description: A unified result event emitted on a meaningful edge of a handshake conversation and delivered to the registered endpoint of the party it is owed to. INVARIANT: human interaction that creates signal is reported back to the counterparty; agent-scale discovery that no human acted on terminates silently. The thousands of ambient L1/L2 conversations a passively-discoverable seeker fans out across emit NO signal when they die at L1/L2 — only meaningful, human-touched, or identity-crossing edges signal. A signal NEVER carries downstream behaviour (the protocol drafts/sends nothing); it states what happened and, where relevant, where. What a receiving product does with a signal (Writer drafts, recruiter inbox row, CRM webhook, nothing) is operator-defined and out of protocol scope. The protocol states WHAT resolved (signal_type, decided_by); whether and how a resolution is billable is entirely operator-defined and is NOT carried on the wire.

event_id.description: Idempotency key — receivers MUST deduplicate by this.

signal_type.description: l2_delivered = L2 disclosure arrived at the vacancy (owed_to vacancy). l3_initiated = a human/poster reached for identity, the seeker is being asked (owed_to seeker). l3_disclosed = identity was released — INCLUDING agent-pre-authorized auto-fire the seeker did not witness; MUST carry destination (owed_to seeker). l2_no_match = a human-initiated (direct-apply) conversation terminated at the validator strong-fit gate; owed_to seeker ONLY when the L1 fire was initiated_by=human — agent-initiated discovery that fails L2 emits nothing. l2_refused / l3_refused = a party declined; a refusal is a resolved signal (owed_to the counterparty), and at L3 it is billable.

owed_to.description: Which party this signal is reported to. Determined by who performed the act being reported on, not who emitted the event.

decided_by.description: Who produced this outcome. For refusals, the party that declined. For l2_no_match, 'validator'. For expiry-driven results, 'system'. Absent for plain deliveries (l2_delivered).

reason.description: Optional machine-readable category for analytics. Receivers MUST NOT surface user-facing text from this field without sanitization.

destination.description: REQUIRED when signal_type=l3_disclosed. Tells a seeker who never witnessed an auto-fire WHERE their identity went — the structural floor for agent-pre-authorized disclosure. Names the receiving vacancy/operator; does not describe what they will do with it.

operator.description: Domain of the operator whose endpoint received the L3 event.
